description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

TikTok is hiring a Backend Software Engineer for its Privacy & Security Data Lifecycle Management team. The role builds global services and privacy engineering platforms that protect sensitive user data throughout its lifecycle while supporting business needs. It also develops privacy-preserving data technologies and collaborates with cross-functional teams to apply these solutions across TikTok products.
Backend Software Engineer designing privacy engineering frameworks and platforms, building anonymization, pseudonymization, and encryption capabilities.

Responsibilities:
• Design and build services to protect user sensitive data with privacy design by default
• Be responsible for the system design and functionality development of the privacy engineering frameworks and platforms
• Work on anonymization/pseudonymization/encryption technologies to preserve user privacy in data processing activities
• Work closely with cross-functional teams to address technical challenges when applying solutions throughout our product suite

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, strong internship or project experience will also be considered
• Solid understanding of computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, operating systems, networking, and common server architectures
• Proficiency in at least one general-purpose programming language, such as Java, Go, C++, or Python, and experience building or maintaining backend services
• Ability to analyze business requirements, break down problems, and deliver reliable, maintainable technical solutions with guidance from senior engineers
• Strong communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners

Preferred:
• Interest in or exposure to privacy engineering, data protection, security, or data governance
• Familiarity with distributed systems, microservices, databases, message queues, or cloud-native infrastructure
• Hands-on experience building AI Agent applications, including agent workflow design and tool integration
• Experience through work, internships, or projects with data protection techniques such as access control, encryption, anonymization, or data classification
• Demonstrated curiosity, ownership, and eagerness to learn in a fast-paced global product environment
